bots.title: Group bots
bots.empty: No bots in this group yet
bots.removeConfirm: Remove “{{name}}” from this group? Its webhook URL stops working immediately.
bots.ownerOnlyHint: Only the group owner can add bots or view and change webhook settings.
bots.builtinHint: Built-in assistants ship with the product and cannot be removed; turning one off stops its notifications in this group.
bots.helpIntro: POST JSON to a bot's webhook URL and the message appears in this group under that bot's name. The request format matches Feishu custom bots, so an existing script only needs a new URL.
bots.helpSignBody: When enabled every request must carry timestamp and sign. The secret is the HMAC key and the signed data is empty — identical to Feishu.
bots.helpLimitsBody: 100 requests/minute and 5/second per bot; request bodies up to 20 KB. Send X-Request-Id on retries so the same id only posts once.

catalog.customDesc: Push messages from your own service into this group via webhook

form.title: Custom bot
form.name: Bot name
form.descPlaceholder: One line about what this bot does

webhook.title: Webhook URL
webhook.hint: POST to this URL to send into this group. The URL is a credential — do not share it.

callback.title: Button callback
callback.hint: Notify this address when a member clicks a card button. https only; leave empty to turn it off.
callback.secretHint: Give this to the external service. Every callback carries an X-WeMeet-Signature header; the service verifies it with this key to confirm the request really came from here. This is a different key from the one under Security above — opposite direction, independent of each other.
callback.rotateConfirm: Den ausgehenden Signaturschlüssel erneuern? Der empfangende Dienst muss den neuen Schlüssel übernehmen, sonst schlägt die Signaturprüfung ab dem nächsten Callback fehl. Auch die Pseudonyme der Klickenden (actor.id) ändern sich – jede Deduplizierung oder Ratenbegrenzung pro Akteur auf deren Seite beginnt von vorn.
callback.rotateDone: Erneuert. Hinterlegen Sie den neuen Signaturschlüssel beim empfangenden Dienst.
callback.identityHint: By default only an anonymous per-bot identifier is sent: the external service can tell whether it is the same person twice, but not who. Turning this on also sends the clicker's name.
callback.disabled: Turned off automatically after repeated failures. Save the address again to re-enable it.

urlError.port: Dieser Port ist nicht zulässig – nur 443.
urlError.address: Diese Adresse ist nicht zulässig: Private und reservierte Adressen können keine Callback-Ziele sein.

reason.timeout: The service did not answer in time
reason.unreachable: The address could not be reached

security.title: Security
security.hint: Turn on at least one — otherwise anyone with the URL can post here.
security.resetConfirm: Rotating invalidates the old secret immediately; services still using it will fail. Continue?
security.resetDone: Secret rotated. Reveal the new value under “Secret” and update your service.
security.keywordPlaceholder: Type and press Enter; click a keyword to remove it
security.keywordsHint: A message must contain at least one keyword to be delivered. Leave empty for no restriction.
security.ipAllowlistHint: One IP or CIDR per line. Leave empty for no restriction.
